## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC merger announcement and form-of TRA

- 2016-03-23: 8-K filed under this LLC's CIK announcing the Merger Agreement with WL Ross Holding Corp.; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit 10.2 (85% sharing of net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups, Blocker NOLs, and imputed interest)
- 2016-06-09: Business combination closes; TRA executed under PubCo CIK 0001604416

#### Termination at Univar merger

- 2019-03-01: TRA terminated for a negotiated $60.0M payment at the close of the Univar acquisition; documented under PubCo CIK 0001604416

## Explanation

Nexeo Solutions Holdings, LLC was the privately held LLC acquired by WL Ross Holding Corp. in the June 9, 2016 SPAC business combination; the LLC was itself a voluntary SEC filer because of registered notes outstanding, and so filed the form-of Tax Receivable Agreement under its own CIK as Exhibit 10.2 to the merger-announcement 8-K. The post-merger PubCo (WL Ross renamed Nexeo Solutions, Inc.) is the actual TRA obligor and executed the contract at closing, obligating it to pay 85% of net realized tax benefits from the Section 754 basis step-ups, the pre-existing Nexeo LLC attributes, the TPG Accolade Blocker NOLs, and imputed interest, to TPG-affiliated beneficiaries. The TRA was terminated at the March 1, 2019 close of the Univar acquisition for a negotiated $60.0M payment. The full executed contract history, including the termination agreement, lives under PubCo CIK 0001604416; see `../nexeo-solutions-inc_0001604416/nexeo-solutions-inc_summary.qmd`. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record on this LLC CIK.
